fact: Themberchaud is described as too fat and lazy to notice the party's absence for years.
source_quote: Themberchaud is "too fat and lazy." It would take him years to realise the party isn't coming back.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud would likely burn the city to cinders if he learned of the egg.
source_quote: The red dragon hungered for information and would likely burn the city to cinders if he learned of the egg.
subject: Themberchaud threat assessment

fact: Gyrgum expresses a strong preference for avoiding conflict with red dragons.
source_quote: Gyrgum was "a big fan of not pissing off red dragons."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Errde Blackskull is the leader of the Stone Guard.
source_quote: The Stone Guard's leader wanted proof that the Council of Savants was behind the city's corruption.
subject: Errde Blackskull

fact: Errde Blackskull would march on the king if she learned the king supports the Assassin's Guild.
source_quote: She would almost certainly march on the king himself if she learned the full truth: the Assassin's Guild "that doesn't exist" was actually being supported by the king.
subject: Errde Blackskull

fact: Errde Blackskull would try to kill all derro if told only about their demonic dealings.
source_quote: If she were told only about the derro and their demonic dealings, she would try to kill all the derro.
subject: Errde Blackskull

fact: The Keepers of the Flame are led by Gartokkar and are close to the king.
source_quote: Led by Gartokkar and close to the king, they simply wanted their egg returned.
subject: The Keepers of the Flame

fact: The Keepers of the Flame are looking for an excuse to commit genocide against the derro.
source_quote: They were also looking for an excuse to go genocidal on the derro.
subject: The Keepers of the Flame

fact: The Keepers of the Flame intend to pursue the party to the end of time if the egg is not returned.
source_quote: They had made it abundantly clear they would pursue the party "to the end of time" if it was not returned.
subject: The Keepers of the Flame

fact: The Keepers of the Flame want to hatch the dragon egg to use the resulting dragon against another dragon.
source_quote: The Keepers wanted to hatch the egg to have a dragon of their own to take on the other dragon.
subject: The Keepers of the Flame

fact: Gartokkar is the leader of the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: Led by Gartokkar and close to the king, they simply wanted their egg returned.
subject: Gartokkar

fact: The assassin gangster was a man who wanted to be scrubbed from the assassins' list.
source_quote: The party had already dealt with the man who wanted to be scrubbed from the assassins' list.
subject: The assassin gangster

fact: The party holds documentation on the Assassin's Guild that its owners believe was burned.
source_quote: Daz notes they hold documentation on the Assassin's Guild that its owners don't know about, "because we burn the table and they think it's burned."
subject: Assassin's Guild documentation

fact: Clan Ironhead is a weaponsmithing clan.
source_quote: Clan Ironhead, a weaponsmithing clan that would happily deal with the gnomes if the Deepking were removed.
subject: Clan Ironhead

fact: Clan Ironhead is the faction most supportive of the gnome kingdoms.
source_quote: Zalthir asked which faction was most pro-gnome. The answer was Clan Ironhead
subject: Clan Ironhead

fact: New leadership in Gracklstugh would be friendlier to the gnome kingdoms, whose trade is currently blocked by the king.
source_quote: if something happened to the Deepking, new leadership would be far friendlier to the gnome kingdoms, whose trade the current king was blocking.
subject: regime change benefit

fact: Gyrgum rolled a Religion check for 18 to determine the dragon egg's status.
source_quote: he rolled his dragon check with Religion instead, for an 18.
subject: Gyrgum's dragon check

fact: Gyrgum attempted a Nature check first, rolling a 12 with a -1 modifier.
source_quote: Gyrgum had only a −1 in Nature... He first rolled Nature (a 12, with a −1 modifier)
subject: Gyrgum's Nature check

fact: The dragon egg will hatch of its own accord in forty-four weeks.
source_quote: the DM ruled that the egg would hatch of its own accord in forty-four weeks.
subject: Dragon Egg

fact: The dragon egg is possessed by a demon.
source_quote: it was corrupted by a demon that possessed it. It "might be possessed by a demon. Details."
subject: Dragon Egg

fact: Gyrgum's lesser restoration spell would not lift the demonic corruption from the egg.
source_quote: Lesser restoration would not lift the demonic corruption
subject: Lesser Restoration attempt

fact: Removing the demonic corruption from the egg would require research.
source_quote: and removing it would take research.
subject: Purging research

fact: Gyrgum resolves to consult his superiors at the Church of Bahamut regarding demonic dragons.
source_quote: As a follower of Bahamut, Gyrgum resolved to consult his superiors about demonic dragons.
subject: Gyrgum's consultation plan

fact: Thorin expressed a wish for the party to have a baby dragon of their own.
source_quote: Thorin wished aloud for a little baby dragon of their own.
subject: Thorin

fact: Zalthir is a dragonborn who felt dissed by Thorin's comment about a baby dragon.
source_quote: Zalthir the dragonborn standing right there... Zalthir was "feeling a little bit like, you know, dissed right now"
subject: Zalthir

fact: Thorin apologised to Zalthir for the comment about the baby dragon.
source_quote: Thorin apologised, saying he hadn't realised it came out that way.
subject: Thorin's apology

fact: The party decided to return the egg to Gartokkar in exchange for safe passage.
source_quote: They would return the egg to Gartokkar. Gartokkar would probably let them leave the city in exchange
subject: Party's final decision

fact: The party hopes to parlay the return of the egg into rights to buy minerals for the gnomes.
source_quote: and the egg might be parlayed into rights to buy the minerals the gnomes wanted.
subject: Mineral trade rights

fact: The party plans to tell the Keepers of the Flame that they found no evidence of who was behind the theft.
source_quote: They would tell the Keepers they had found no evidence of who was behind the theft.
subject: Keepers' deception

fact: The party decided to hide the list connecting the Deepking to the Assassin's Guild from Errde Blackskull.
source_quote: The incriminating list connecting the Deepking to the Assassin's Guild would stay hidden from Errde's volatile temper.
subject: Hidden assassination list

fact: Zalthir hopes to leave Clan Ironhead in a stronger position before departing.
source_quote: Clan Ironhead was the one faction Zalthir hoped to leave in a stronger position.
subject: Zalthir
